name: running-ai-mcp-gateway
description: OAuth 2.1 resource-server gateway in front of the RunningAI read-only MCP (Phase 7C-2b). Verifies Auth0-issued JWTs (issuer/audience/signature/exp/nbf/scope/sub, RS256 via remote JWKS) and proxies ONLY allowlisted read tools to a local MCP endpoint. Fail closed.
